description: This power represents flora and ecosystems: primeval oak woodlands, boreal conifer taiga, dense tropical triple-canopy rainforests, tidal mangrove labyrinths, and waving amber steppes with date palm oases.
fantasticalDescription: This power represents fantastical vegetation: colossal World-Trees bridging cloud layers, bioluminescent fungal forests glowing in twilight, predatory brambles, and orchards of weeping starlight-fruit.
examples: Ancient Old-Growth Forests, Subarctic Taiga, Dense Jungle Rainforests, Mangrove Coastlines, Golden Steppes, and Desert Oases.
creativePrompts: How old is this forest canopy, and what forgotten ancient seeds slumber beneath its moss?
How do the plants defend themselves against storms, droughts, and primordial beasts?
Does this flora produce valuable spices, rare lumber, or strange psychoactive resins?
exampleNarratives: Towering cedar sentinels rose hundreds of feet, cloaking the continent in a dense, mossy green silence.
A tidal mangrove labyrinth locked roots with the sea floor, buffering the mainland against ocean storm surges.
Subarctic spruce taiga stretched across endless permafrost, glowing with silver frost under the pale moon.
